instructions_to_main_agent: Use exact color code #329937 for brand green primary buttons and active badges.
Implement auto CRM lookup when phone number reaches 10 digits in CheckInPage.jsx.
Display returning guest badge with Gold Tier, stay count, last stay, wallet credit, and document status when guest profile exists.
Show subtle 'New Guest' pill when customer is not found in CRM without blocking check-in flow.
Include expandable Extra Adults slots (Adult 2, 3, 4 names) controlled by Adults counter.
Include individual Children name inputs when Children counter > 0.
Add Corporate / B2B toggle revealing Firm Name and GSTIN fields.
Provide amber non-blocking warning banner when CRM lookup service fails or times out.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for stable testability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure contrast ratio meets WCAG AA standards against #F7F7F7 and #FFFFFF backgrounds.
Avoid universal transition CSS property; target specific transform and background transitions.
Use specific icon set from lucide-react (or SVG strings in HTML mockup).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
